title: Flight Route Validator
spec: Write `route(payload)` to validate travel plans, taking a tuple with a list of flight tuples (origin, destination, carrier, aircraft, fare class, passenger type) and six sets of approved data. Return a tuple containing a list of valid flights and a list of rejection strings. Check fields sequentially and reject with a specific string if a check fails: reject if the origin is absent from the active hubs. Reject if the destination is missing from the active hubs; reject if the carrier fails to appear in the partner airlines. Reject if the aircraft is absent from the certified aircraft set; reject if the fare class is missing from the permitted fares; reject if the passenger type fails to appear in the eligible passengers. For approved flights, add the destination country to a travel log if it is absent from the log. Also, schedule a gate if the destination airport is missing from the scheduled airports list.

title: Financial Transaction Cleanser
spec: Implement `cleanse(batch)` to filter financial records, taking a tuple with a list of transaction tuples (currency, country, merchant category, network, terminal type, status) and six sets of valid parameters. Return a tuple of cleansed transactions and a list of string reasons for any rejected transactions. Check sequentially: reject if the currency is absent from the supported currencies, or reject if the country is missing from the allowed regions. Reject if the merchant category fails to appear in the low risk merchants, or if the network is absent from the contracted networks. Reject if the terminal type is missing from the secure terminals, or if the status fails to appear in the finalized states. For clean transactions, add the merchant to a trusted list if it is absent from the current trusted list. Furthermore, append the country to a foreign routing queue if it is missing from the domestic routing list.

title: Medical Patient Triage
spec: Write `triage(data)` to prioritize incoming cases, taking a tuple of patient tuples (symptom, age group, insurance, clinic, doctor, priority level) and six sets of approved criteria. Return a list of admitted patients and a list of specific denial reasons. Validate sequentially: drop the record if the symptom is absent from the treatable conditions, or drop if the age group is missing from the handled demographics. Drop if the insurance fails to appear in the accepted insurance set, or if the clinic is absent from the open branches. Drop if the doctor is missing from the scheduled doctors, or if the priority level fails to appear in the emergency tiers. For admitted patients, add the doctor to a notification roster if they are absent from the already notified doctors. Finally, assign a general bed if the clinic is missing from the intensive care wings list.

title: University Course Registrar
spec: Develop `register(requests)` to filter student enrollments, accepting a tuple of request tuples (student identifier, major, course code, department, campus, semester) and six sets of valid criteria. Return a list of approved requests and a list of denial reasons. Deny sequentially with a reason: deny if the student identifier is absent from the active enrollments, or if the major is missing from the degree programs. Deny if the course code fails to appear in the current catalog, or if the department is absent from the funding departments. Deny if the campus is missing from the accessible campuses, or if the semester fails to appear in the open semesters. For successful requests, add the student to a waitlist check if they are absent from the guaranteed seating list. Additionally, flag the course for extra capacity if it is missing from the standard lecture halls list.

title: Supply Chain Router
spec: Implement `route(manifests)` to filter shipping logistics, taking a tuple of shipment tuples (origin warehouse, destination port, transit mode, container type, customs broker, freight forwarder) and six sets of operational data. Return a list of routed shipments and a list of hold reasons. Hold sequentially with a specific reason: hold if the origin warehouse is absent from the active warehouses. Hold if the destination port is missing from the open ports, or if the transit mode fails to appear in the contracted carriers. Hold if the container type is absent from the available inventory, or if the customs broker is missing from the licensed agents. Hold if the freight forwarder fails to appear in the preferred vendors. For routed shipments, add the container type to a special handling list if it is absent from the standard containers list. Finally, schedule an inspection if the destination port is missing from the precleared ports set.

title: Real Estate Listing Scrubber
spec: Create `scrub(database)` to sanitize property listings, accepting a tuple of property tuples (property type, zoning, county, school district, heating system, roof type) and six sets of acceptable criteria. Return the valid properties alongside a list of filtering reasons for rejected ones. Filter sequentially: exclude the property if its type is absent from the residential categories, or if the zoning is missing from the permitted zones. Exclude if the county fails to appear in the service areas, or if the school district is absent from the top districts. Exclude if the heating system is missing from the efficient systems, or if the roof type fails to appear in the insurable materials. For valid properties, add the county to a marketing blast if it is absent from the current campaign list. Also, tag the property for an upgrade check if the heating system is missing from the newly installed systems set.

title: Software Bug Triage
spec: Write `triage(tickets)` to filter issue tracker reports, taking a tuple of issue tuples (repository, component, severity, operating system, browser, reporter) and six sets of active configurations. Return a list of triaged issues and a list of reasons for any ignored issues. Ignore sequentially with a reason: ignore if the repository is absent from the maintained projects, or if the component is missing from the core modules. Ignore if the severity fails to appear in the critical levels, or if the operating system is absent from the supported platforms. Ignore if the browser is missing from the modern browsers, or if the reporter fails to appear in the trusted testers. For valid issues, add the reporter to a reward list if they are absent from the previously rewarded list. Furthermore, assign a senior reviewer if the component is missing from the community supported modules list.

title: E-commerce Order Fulfiller
spec: Implement `fulfill(batches)` to process shopping checkouts, taking a tuple of order tuples (payment method, shipping country, courier, product category, discount code, user tier) and six sets of verified data. Return a list of processed orders and a list of cancellation reasons. Cancel sequentially with a distinct reason: cancel if the payment method is absent from the secured methods, or if the shipping country is missing from the export zones. Cancel if the courier fails to appear in the integrated partners, or if the product category is absent from the stock categories. Cancel if the discount code is missing from the active promotions, or if the user tier fails to appear in the loyalty tiers. For fulfilled orders, add a free gift if the product category is absent from the heavy items list. Additionally, send a priority notification if the user tier is missing from the basic members list.

title: Smart Home Automation Engine
spec: Create `automate(telemetry)` to filter sensor events, accepting a tuple of event tuples (sensor type, room, time of day, trigger type, action category, user profile) and six sets of authorized rules. Return the authorized events and a list of rejection reasons. Discard sequentially: discard if the sensor type is absent from the registered devices, or if the room is missing from the monitored zones. Discard if the time of day fails to appear in the active schedules, or if the trigger type is absent from the recognized gestures. Discard if the action category is missing from the permitted actions, or if the user profile fails to appear in the administrator groups. For authorized events, activate the security cameras if the room is absent from the privacy zones list. Lastly, log the action if the action category is missing from the silent background tasks set.

title: Recipe Meal Planner
spec: Write `plan(diet)` to filter recipe suggestions, taking a tuple of recipe tuples (cuisine, difficulty, main protein, cooking method, dietary restriction, meal type) and six sets of dietary profiles. Return the approved recipes alongside a list of skip reasons. Skip sequentially with a reason: skip if the cuisine is absent from the family favorites, or if the difficulty is missing from the weekday levels. Skip if the main protein fails to appear in the available proteins, or if the cooking method is absent from the appliance capabilities. Skip if the dietary restriction is missing from the tolerated diets, or if the meal type fails to appear in the planned meals. For approved recipes, add the main protein to a grocery list if it is absent from the pantry inventory list. Also, recommend a side salad if the cooking method is missing from the vegetable heavy methods set.

title: Network Traffic Firewall
spec: Develop `filter(traffic)` to drop malicious network packets, taking a tuple of packet tuples (protocol, source port, destination port, payload signature, origin country, encryption cypher) and six sets of safe configurations. Return a list of safe packets and a list of drop reasons. Drop sequentially: drop if the protocol is absent from the allowed protocols, or if the source port is missing from the safe source ports. Drop if the destination port fails to appear in the open destination ports, or if the payload signature is absent from the benign signatures. Drop if the origin country is missing from the whitelisted jurisdictions, or if the encryption cypher fails to appear in the strong cyphers. For allowed packets, flag the origin country for review if it is absent from the domestic territories list. Add the destination port to a monitoring list if it is missing from the commonly used ports set.

title: Music Playlist Generator
spec: Implement `generate(library)` to curate songs, accepting a tuple of track tuples (genre, decade, tempo, mood, language, record label) and six sets of energetic criteria. Return the finalized tracks and a list of exclusion reasons. Exclude sequentially: exclude if the genre is absent from the upbeat genres, or if the decade is missing from the retro decades. Exclude if the tempo fails to appear in the running tempos, or if the mood is absent from the workout moods. Exclude if the language is missing from the understood languages, or if the record label fails to appear in the cleared publishers. For included tracks, add the decade to a diversity tracker if it is absent from the currently represented decades. Finally, queue a vocal drop if the tempo is missing from the extreme speed categories list.

title: HR Resume Screener
spec: Write `screen(pool)` to filter job applicant profiles, taking a tuple of candidate tuples (degree, university, programming language, spoken language, visa status, job role) and six sets of corporate requirements. Return the shortlisted candidates and a list of rejection reasons. Reject sequentially: reject if their degree is absent from the required degrees, or if their university is missing from the accredited institutions. Reject if their programming language fails to appear in the stack requirements, or if their spoken language is absent from the business languages. Reject if their visa status is missing from the sponsored statuses, or if their job role fails to appear in the open positions. For shortlisted candidates, send an assessment link if their programming language is absent from the automatically verified languages list. Also, flag the application for relocation assistance if the university is missing from the local region colleges set.

title: Automated Trading Bot
spec: Create `trade(market)` to filter algorithmic trading signals, taking a tuple of signal tuples (asset class, exchange, order type, indicator, time frame, currency pair) and six sets of risk parameters. Return the valid signals and a list of ignore reasons. Ignore sequentially: ignore if the asset class is absent from the approved assets, or if the exchange is missing from the connected exchanges. Ignore if the order type fails to appear in the supported orders, or if the indicator is absent from the backtested strategies. Ignore if the time frame is missing from the intraday intervals, or if the currency pair fails to appear in the liquid pairs. For valid signals, add the exchange to a priority list if it is absent from the high latency exchanges set. Furthermore, attach a strict stop loss if the currency pair is missing from the low volatility pairs list.

title: Cybersecurity Log Analyzer
spec: Develop `analyze(audit)` to filter benign access logs, accepting a tuple of log tuples (event identifier, user role, access method, target resource, action type, status code) and six sets of baseline profiles. Return the benign logs and a list of flag reasons. Flag sequentially: flag if the event identifier is absent from the standard system events, or if the user role is missing from the basic access roles. Flag if the access method fails to appear in the secure methods, or if the target resource is absent from the public directories. Flag if the action type is missing from the read only actions, or if the status code fails to appear in the successful responses. For benign logs, archive the target resource if it is absent from the ephemeral storage list. Also, alert the audit team if the access method is missing from the internally trusted networks set.

title: Event Ticket Scalper Defense
spec: Implement `validate(transactions)` to cancel fraudulent ticket purchases, taking a tuple of purchase tuples (payment gateway, email domain, region, browser agent, delivery method, seating tier) and six sets of verified markers. Return the legitimate transactions and a list of void reasons. Void sequentially: void if the payment gateway is absent from the verified gateways, or if the email domain is missing from the reputable providers. Void if the region fails to appear in the domestic areas, or if the browser agent is absent from the standard browsers. Void if the delivery method is missing from the digital delivery, or if the seating tier fails to appear in the general admission. For legitimate transactions, request additional identification if the region is absent from the immediate local zip codes list. Attach a digital receipt if the email domain is missing from the paper only request lists.

title: Video Game Asset Loader
spec: Write `load(resources)` to filter game files, accepting a tuple of asset tuples (file extension, texture resolution, audio format, model complexity, animation type, material shader) and six sets of engine constraints. Return the loaded assets and a list of skip reasons. Skip sequentially: skip if the file extension is absent from the supported formats, or if the texture resolution is missing from the optimized bounds. Skip if the audio format fails to appear in the compressed formats, or if the model complexity is absent from the low polygon counts. Skip if the animation type is missing from the humanoid rigs, or if the material shader fails to appear in the precompiled shaders. For loaded assets, queue a background stream if the texture resolution is absent from the ultra low resolutions list. Additionally, apply a fallback material if the material shader is missing from the core engine shaders set.

title: Hotel Reservation Manager
spec: Create `manage(reservations)` to filter booking requests, taking a tuple of booking tuples (room type, booking channel, rate plan, guest tier, cancellation policy, payment status) and six sets of availability rules. Return the accepted bookings and a list of decline reasons. Decline sequentially: decline if the room type is absent from the available inventory, or if the booking channel is missing from the direct partners. Decline if the rate plan fails to appear in the active promotions, or if the guest tier is absent from the recognized programs. Decline if the cancellation policy is missing from the standard policies, or if the payment status fails to appear in the cleared funds. For accepted bookings, offer a late checkout if the guest tier is absent from the basic guest lists. Furthermore, require a security deposit if the booking channel is missing from the corporate trusted partners set.

title: Car Rental Fleet Assigner
spec: Implement `assign(rentals)` to filter vehicle checkout requests, accepting a tuple of request tuples (vehicle class, transmission type, fuel type, pickup location, dropoff location, insurance tier) and six sets of operational constraints. Return the approved requests and a list of rejection reasons. Reject sequentially: reject if the vehicle class is absent from the current fleet, or if the transmission type is missing from the licensed driving types. Reject if the fuel type fails to appear in the eco friendly options, or if the pickup location is absent from the regional branches. Reject if the dropoff location is missing from the partner garages, or if the insurance tier fails to appear in the comprehensive plans. For approved requests, issue a toll pass if the pickup location is absent from the toll free jurisdictions list. Send a refueling reminder if the fuel type is missing from the electric vehicle categories set.

title: Library Book Checkout System
spec: Write `checkout(circulation)` to filter book borrowing attempts, taking a tuple of loan tuples (borrower type, media format, genre category, publishing house, condition rating, language edition) and six sets of circulation rules. Return the permitted loans and a list of denial reasons. Deny sequentially: deny if the borrower type is absent from the active patrons, or if the media format is missing from the circulating collections. Deny if the genre category fails to appear in the general reading, or if the publishing house is absent from the approved educational publishers. Deny if the condition rating is missing from the acceptable wear levels, or if the language edition fails to appear in the community supported languages. For permitted loans, apply a protective cover if the condition rating is absent from the pristine condition lists. Restrict the loan period if the genre category is missing from the long term study materials set.

title: Restaurant Menu Configurator
spec: Develop `configure(kitchen)` to filter dinner orders, accepting a tuple of order tuples (dish category, spice level, protein choice, side dish, sauce option, allergy warning) and six sets of culinary rules. Return the valid orders and a list of invalidation reasons. Invalidate sequentially: invalidate if the dish category is absent from the dinner menu, or if the spice level is missing from the standard levels. Invalidate if the protein choice fails to appear in the defrosted stock, or if the side dish is absent from the seasonal vegetables. Invalidate if the sauce option is missing from the dairy free sauces, or if the allergy warning fails to appear in the safe lists. For valid orders, assign a senior chef if the protein choice is absent from the easy preparation meats list. Serve with a complimentary dessert if the side dish is missing from the high calorie sides set.

title: Fitness App Workout Builder
spec: Implement `build(sessions)` to filter exercise routines, taking a tuple of routine tuples (exercise type, equipment needed, muscle group, difficulty tier, duration block, mobility requirement) and six sets of user constraints. Return the kept routines and a list of exclusion reasons. Exclude sequentially: exclude if the exercise type is absent from the cardiovascular activities, or if the equipment needed is missing from the home gym inventory. Exclude if the muscle group fails to appear in the upper body focus, or if the difficulty tier is absent from the beginner levels. Exclude if the duration block is missing from the quick intervals, or if the mobility requirement fails to appear in the safe ranges. For kept routines, add a warmup phase if the difficulty tier is absent from the absolute lowest levels list. Also, suggest a hydration break if the duration block is missing from the under ten minutes categories.

title: Podcast Episode Publisher
spec: Create `publish(syndication)` to filter audio uploads, accepting a tuple of episode tuples (audio format, bitrate, topic category, guest affiliation, sponsorship tier, explicit rating) and six sets of platform rules. Return the published episodes and a list of block reasons. Block sequentially: block if the audio format is absent from the streaming standards, or if the bitrate is missing from the high fidelity ranges. Block if the topic category fails to appear in the network themes, or if the guest affiliation is absent from the vetted organizations. Block if the sponsorship tier is missing from the active campaigns, or if the explicit rating fails to appear in the family friendly ratings. For published episodes, route the file to manual transcription if the topic category is absent from the auto transcription supported topics list. Insert a disclaimer audio clip if the guest affiliation is missing from the internal host list.

title: Museum Exhibit Curator
spec: Write `curate(collection)` to filter artifacts for a gallery, taking a tuple of artifact tuples (historical period, material composition, origin region, preservation state, artist movement, acquisition method) and six sets of exhibition themes. Return the exhibited artifacts and a list of storage reasons. Store sequentially: store if the historical period is absent from the timeline, or if the material composition is missing from the safe materials. Store if the origin region fails to appear in the featured continents, or if the preservation state is absent from the display ready conditions. Store if the artist movement is missing from the modern art themes, or if the acquisition method fails to appear in the ethical procurement channels. For exhibited artifacts, place them behind glass if the material composition is absent from the highly durable materials list. Assign an audio guide segment if the historical period is missing from the widely understood eras set.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Provisioner
spec: Implement `provision(deployments)` to filter server requests, accepting a tuple of request tuples (instance type, operating system, storage class, network zone, backup policy, security group) and six sets of security baselines. Return the approved requests and a list of rejection reasons. Reject sequentially: reject if the instance type is absent from the allowed quota sizes, or if the operating system is missing from the patched baseline images. Reject if the storage class fails to appear in the cost optimized tiers, or if the network zone is absent from the public subnets. Reject if the backup policy is missing from the daily retention schedules, or if the security group fails to appear in the baseline firewall profiles. For approved requests, flag for managerial sign off if the instance type is absent from the micro instance lists. Enable deep monitoring if the network zone is missing from the internally isolated subnets set.

title: Email Campaign Filter
spec: Filter subscribers by dividing the validation into profile checks, technical checks, and status checks. The entry point is `filter(subscribers)`. A subscriber fails profile checks if their email domain is missing from the allowed domains list, their country is absent from the serviced countries, or their language is missing from the supported languages. They fail technical checks if their client application is absent from the compatible clients, their time zone is missing from the active time zones, or their referral source is missing from the approved sources. Finally, they fail status checks if their subscription tier lacks presence in the eligible tiers, or their account status is absent from the valid statuses. Return a list of valid subscriber names. Example input: a list of subscriber records. Example output: a list of names like [Alice, Bob].

title: Social Media Content Moderator
spec: Filter out invalid posts by splitting the work into author checks, content checks, and metadata checks. The entry point is `moderate(posts)`. Author checks fail if the author is missing from the verified users list, or their intended audience tier is absent from the valid audience tiers. Content checks fail if the primary language is absent from the monitored languages, the category lacks presence in the safe categories, or the topic is missing from the trending topics. Metadata checks fail if the origin country is missing from the allowed regions, the attached media type is absent from the permitted media types, or the source application lacks presence in the trusted applications list. Return the clean posts. Example input: a list of post records. Example output: a list of approved post identifiers like [101, 105].

title: Online Multiplayer Matchmaker
spec: Assign players to a game session by performing network checks, hardware checks, and preference checks. The entry point is `matchmake(players)`. Network checks discard a player if their server region is missing from the active regions, their connection protocol lacks presence in the supported protocols, or their network provider lacks presence in the optimized providers list. Hardware checks discard if their platform is absent from the crossplay platforms, or their input device is missing from the fair play devices. Preference checks discard if their rank is absent from the eligible ranks, their game mode preference is missing from the available modes, or their audio language is absent from the requested languages. Return the accepted players. Example input: a list of player records. Example output: a list of player names like [Hero99, Ninja22].

title: Board Game Validator
spec: Check proposed moves against rules using board checks, piece checks, and strategy checks. The entry point is `validate(moves)`. Board checks mark a move invalid if the destination row is missing from the board rows, the destination column is absent from the board columns, or the target square terrain is missing from the walkable terrains. Piece checks mark it invalid if the piece type lacks presence in the active piece types, the player color is missing from the current turn colors, or the move type is absent from the permitted move types. Strategy checks mark it invalid if the applied strategy is absent from the known strategies, or the speed category lacks presence in the allowed speeds. Return the valid moves. Example input: a list of move records. Example output: a list of move identifiers like [M1, M4].

title: Dietary Meal Validator
spec: Filter ingredients for a specific dietary plan via nutrition checks, safety checks, and sourcing checks. The entry point is `plan(ingredients)`. Nutrition checks reject an ingredient if its food group is missing from the allowed food groups, its flavor profile lacks presence in the desired profiles, or its primary vitamin is missing from the required vitamins. Safety checks skip if its preparation method is absent from the safe methods, its texture is absent from the acceptable textures, or its color lacks presence in the appealing colors list. Sourcing checks drop the ingredient if its origin country is missing from the trusted origins, or its packaging type is absent from the eco friendly types. Return the approved ingredients. Example input: a list of ingredient records. Example output: a list of ingredient names like [Carrot, Spinach].

title: Bank Fraud Detector
spec: Scrutinize transactions for clearance by performing entity checks, technical checks, and route checks. The entry point is `analyze(transactions)`. Entity checks skip a transaction if its currency is missing from the supported currencies list, the merchant category is absent from the trusted categories, or the user account tier is absent from the eligible tiers. Technical checks drop the transaction if the device operating system lacks presence in the secure systems, the authentication method is missing from the verified methods, or the transaction type is missing from the standard types. Route checks exclude the transaction if the clearing network is absent from the partnered networks, or the destination bank country lacks presence in the cleared countries list. Return the safe transactions. Example input: a list of transaction records. Example output: a list of transaction identifiers like [TX100, TX102].

title: Automated Exam Grader
spec: Process student exam submissions by separating identity checks, format checks, and environment checks. The entry point is `grade(submissions)`. Identity checks ignore a submission if the student identifier is missing from the enrolled students list, or the subject code is absent from the current semester subjects. Format checks drop the submission if the file format lacks presence in the accepted formats, the font family is missing from the legible fonts, or the grading rubric lacks presence in the standard rubrics. Environment checks exclude the submission if the coding language used is absent from the allowed languages, the operating system environment is missing from the supported environments, or the submission portal is absent from the official portals. Return a list of accepted submissions. Example input: a list of submission records. Example output: a list of student identifiers like [S10, S15].

title: Package Dependency Resolver
spec: Filter software packages for installation using identity checks, compatibility checks, and security checks. The entry point is `resolve(packages)`. Identity checks reject a package if its category is missing from the core categories, its semantic version major is missing from the supported versions, or its maintainer organization lacks presence in the trusted organizations. Compatibility checks skip if its architecture is absent from the compatible architectures, its build system lacks presence in the known build systems, or its runtime environment is absent from the installed environments. Security checks drop the package if its license is missing from the approved licenses list, or its hash algorithm is absent from the secure algorithms. Return valid packages. Example input: a list of package records. Example output: a list of package names like [LibA, LibC].

title: Smart City Traffic Controller
spec: Filter vehicles requesting access to the city center via vehicle checks, purpose checks, and route checks. The entry point is `route(vehicles)`. Vehicle checks deny access if the vehicle class is missing from the permitted classes, the fuel type is absent from the clean energy types, or the vehicle weight category is missing from the safe weight categories. Purpose checks drop the request if the license plate state lacks presence in the partner states, or its transit purpose is absent from the essential purposes. Route checks skip if the entry gate is missing from the open gates, the requested parking zone is absent from the available zones, or its navigation system lacks presence in the integrated systems list. Return the allowed vehicles. Example input: a list of vehicle records. Example output: a list of vehicle license plates like [ABC123, XYZ789].

title: Warehouse Inventory Allocator
spec: Process outbound warehouse orders by routing them through destination checks, product checks, and carrier checks. The entry point is `allocate(orders)`. Destination checks skip an order if the destination state is missing from the shipping zones list, or the delivery speed is absent from the contracted speeds. Product checks drop the order if the product category lacks presence in the current aisle categories, the packaging size is missing from the standard box sizes, or the warehouse section is absent from the operational sections. Carrier checks exclude the order if the carrier company is absent from the preferred carriers, the payment status is missing from the cleared statuses, or the handling requirement lacks presence in the trained handling types. Return the fulfillable orders. Example input: a list of order records. Example output: a list of order identifiers like [ORD1, ORD4].

title: Space Mission Launch Checklist
spec: Evaluate launch parameters by organizing them into hardware checks, environmental checks, and personnel checks. The entry point is `evaluate(parameters)`. Hardware checks abort if the telemetry band is missing from the assigned bands, the payload type is absent from the certified payloads, or the booster stage is absent from the inspected stages. Environmental checks drop the check if the weather condition lacks presence in the acceptable conditions, the launch pad is missing from the active pads, or the recovery ship location is absent from the safe zones. Personnel checks discard if the astronaut role is missing from the required roles, or the communication protocol lacks presence in the secure protocols. Return the passed parameters. Example input: a list of parameter records. Example output: a list of parameter identifiers like [P1, P3].

title: Zoo Animal Transfer Coordinator
spec: Vet animal transfer requests by dividing logic into animal checks, transport checks, and facility checks. The entry point is `transfer(requests)`. Animal checks reject a request if the animal species is missing from the authorized species list, or the diet plan is absent from the stocked diets. Transport checks skip if the transport vehicle is absent from the climate controlled vehicles, the departure time is missing from the approved departure windows, the transfer route is absent from the clear routes, or the sedation method lacks presence in the safe methods list. Facility checks drop the request if the destination habitat lacks presence in the prepared habitats, or the assigned veterinarian is missing from the available veterinarians. Return approved transfers. Example input: a list of transfer records. Example output: a list of transfer identifiers like [TR1, TR2].

title: Theme Park Ride Scheduler
spec: Assign guests to an exclusive ride by running guest checks, physical checks, and logistics checks. The entry point is `schedule(guests)`. Guest checks skip if their ticket tier is missing from the premium tiers, their payment method is absent from the valid methods, or their companion pass type lacks presence in the recognized passes. Physical checks skip if their height category is absent from the safe height categories, or their physical accommodation requirement is absent from the handled accommodations. Logistics checks drop the guest if their selected time slot lacks presence in the operational slots, their boarding group is missing from the called groups, or their language preference is missing from the supported audio languages. Return the scheduled guests. Example input: a list of guest records. Example output: a list of guest names like [John, Mary].

title: Job Interview Coordinator
spec: Filter candidates for the final interview round using academic checks, logistical checks, and performance checks. The entry point is `coordinate(candidates)`. Academic checks reject a candidate if their degree field is missing from the required fields, or their programming language is absent from the tech stack languages. Logistical checks drop the candidate if their timezone lacks presence in the interviewer timezones, their visa status is missing from the eligible statuses, their requested salary band is absent from the budgeted bands, or their availability day is missing from the interview days. Performance checks block the candidate if their assessment score category is absent from the top categories, or their portfolio type lacks presence in the reviewed types. Return the shortlisted candidates. Example input: a list of candidate records. Example output: a list of candidate names like [Eve, Frank].

title: Vintage Car Restorer System
spec: Validate replacement parts for a restoration project by grouping rules into origin checks, specification checks, and condition checks. The entry point is `restore(parts)`. Origin checks skip a part if its manufacturer is missing from the authentic manufacturers list, the sourcing country is missing from the importable countries, or its certification is absent from the safety certifications. Specification checks drop the part if its material is absent from the period correct materials, its thread size lacks presence in the metric sizes, its color code is absent from the factory colors, or its mounting style lacks presence in the compatible styles list. Condition checks ignore if the part condition is missing from the usable conditions. Return the verified parts. Example input: a list of part records. Example output: a list of part serial numbers like [SN123, SN456].

title: Fantasy RPG Quest Giver
spec: Screen adventurers for an epic quest via combat checks, alignment checks, and gear checks. The entry point is `assign(adventurers)`. Combat checks deny an adventurer if their character class is missing from the needed classes, or their reputation level is missing from the trusted levels. Alignment checks skip if their current realm is absent from the connected realms, their magic alignment is missing from the benign alignments, or their guild is absent from the allied guilds. Gear checks drop the adventurer if their primary weapon lacks presence in the effective weapons, their mount type is absent from the flying mounts, or their armor material lacks presence in the resistant materials list. Return the chosen adventurers. Example input: a list of adventurer records. Example output: a list of adventurer names like [Arthur, Lancelot].

title: Airport Baggage Sorter
spec: Route baggage to the correct flights using destination checks, physical checks, and security checks. The entry point is `sort(bags)`. Destination checks skip a bag if its destination airport code is missing from the direct flight codes, or its priority tag lacks presence in the recognized tags list. Physical checks skip if its weight class is absent from the accepted weight classes, its shape category lacks presence in the conveyable shapes, or its handling code is absent from the standard handling codes. Security checks ignore if the passenger transit status is missing from the cleared statuses, the security scan result is missing from the safe results, or its check in terminal is absent from the active terminals. Return the sorted bags. Example input: a list of bag records. Example output: a list of bag tags like [BG1, BG3].

title: Smart Farm Irrigation System
spec: Decide which farm zones to water by running crop checks, environmental checks, and mechanical checks. The entry point is `irrigate(zones)`. Crop checks skip a zone if its crop type is missing from the water intensive crops, or its fertilizer mix lacks presence in the compatible mixes list. Environmental checks skip if its soil type is absent from the fast draining soils, its elevation category lacks presence in the pumpable elevations, or the weather forecast is missing from the dry forecasts. Mechanical checks exclude the zone if its sensor status is absent from the calibrated statuses, the water source is missing from the active reservoirs, or its scheduled phase is absent from the current phases. Return the zones to water. Example input: a list of zone records. Example output: a list of zone identifiers like [Z1, Z2].

title: Film Casting Director
spec: Shortlist actors for a commercial shoot using talent checks, physical checks, and logistical checks. The entry point is `cast(actors)`. Talent checks skip an actor if their union status is missing from the covered statuses list, their vocal range is absent from the required ranges, their dance style lacks presence in the choreographed styles, or their previous experience category lacks presence in the desired categories list. Physical checks ignore if their hair color is missing from the storyboard colors. Logistical checks exclude the actor if their availability month is absent from the shooting months, their agency is missing from the partnered agencies, or their primary residence city is absent from the local cities. Return the cast actors. Example input: a list of actor records. Example output: a list of actor names like [Tom, Zendaya].

title: Municipal Waste Collector
spec: Filter bins for the morning collection route via location checks, physical checks, and schedule checks. The entry point is `collect(bins)`. Location checks skip a bin if its street zone is absent from the morning zones, or its neighborhood is absent from the active neighborhoods. Physical checks drop the bin if its waste category is missing from the recyclable categories, its volume capacity lacks presence in the standard capacities, its bin color is missing from the official colors, its material is absent from the municipal materials, or its locking mechanism lacks presence in the automated mechanisms list. Schedule checks discard if the collection frequency is missing from the daily frequencies. Return the bins to collect. Example input: a list of bin records. Example output: a list of bin identifiers like [B10, B11].

title: Satellite Data Downlinker
spec: Validate telemetry packets from orbit by executing signal checks, encryption checks, and content checks. The entry point is `downlink(packets)`. Signal checks drop a packet if its transmission frequency is absent from the listening frequencies, the ground station is missing from the visible stations, or its modulation type is absent from the demodulated types. Encryption checks exclude the packet if its error correction scheme is absent from the supported schemes, or the encryption tier is missing from the decrypted tiers. Content checks drop the packet if its encoding format is missing from the decodable formats, its mission identifier lacks presence in the active missions, or its priority level lacks presence in the immediate levels list. Return the valid packets. Example input: a list of packet records. Example output: a list of packet identifiers like [PKT1, PKT2].

title: Art Gallery Exhibition Planner
spec: Select artworks for a special gallery wing using curatorial checks, physical checks, and logistical checks. The entry point is `curate(artworks)`. Curatorial checks skip an artwork if its artistic movement is missing from the featured movements, the artist nationality is missing from the showcased nationalities, or its creation century is absent from the theme centuries. Physical checks skip if its medium is absent from the curatorial mediums, its framing style lacks presence in the gallery styles, or its lighting requirement is absent from the available lighting setups. Logistical checks discard if the insurance bracket is missing from the covered brackets, or its loan duration lacks presence in the exhibition durations list. Return the selected artworks. Example input: a list of artwork records. Example output: a list of artwork titles like [MonaLisa, StarryNight].

title: Disaster Relief Dispatcher
spec: Filter relief teams for deployment via personnel checks, equipment checks, and location checks. The entry point is `dispatch(teams)`. Personnel checks skip a team if its medical specialty is missing from the critical specialties list, the team size category is missing from the optimal sizes, its training certification is absent from the valid certifications, or its language skill lacks presence in the local languages list. Equipment checks skip if its transport vehicle is absent from the all terrain vehicles, its communication gear lacks presence in the satellite gear types, or the supply kit type is missing from the emergency kits. Location checks exclude the team if its base location is absent from the nearby locations. Return the deployable teams. Example input: a list of team records. Example output: a list of team names like [Alpha, Bravo].

title: Pet Adoption Matcher
spec: Find suitable families for rescue dogs by applying housing checks, lifestyle checks, and preference checks. The entry point is `match(families)`. Housing checks skip a family if their dwelling type is missing from the fenced dwellings, or their location zone lacks presence in the visitation zones list. Lifestyle checks skip if their activity level is absent from the high activity levels, the family working hours category is missing from the flexible hours, their experience level is absent from the experienced levels, or their child age group is absent from the safe age groups. Preference checks drop the family if their resident pet type lacks presence in the dog friendly types, or their requested dog size is missing from the available sizes. Return the matched families. Example input: a list of family records. Example output: a list of family names like [Smith, Jones].

title: Factory Assembly Line Controller
spec: Validate products before the final assembly stage by separating checks into material checks, electronic checks, and thermal checks. The entry point is `assemble(products)`. Material checks skip a product if its casing material is missing from the approved materials, its wiring harness is absent from the insulated harnesses, or its packaging box lacks presence in the folded boxes list. Electronic checks skip if its microchip model is absent from the flashed models, the screen resolution is missing from the standard resolutions, its firmware version is absent from the stable versions, or its battery type lacks presence in the certified batteries. Thermal checks discard if the cooling mechanism is missing from the tested mechanisms. Return the ready products. Example input: a list of product records. Example output: a list of product serial numbers like [PRD1, PRD2].

title: Textile Quality Inspector
spec: Develop a system to evaluate incoming fabric deliveries. The main function `inspect(rolls)` takes a list of roll records. First, the system must discard any roll if its material is missing from the approved natural fibers list, or if its dye shade is absent from the current seasonal palette. Next, if the thread count is unlisted in the standard density ranges, a warning is raised. A quality score is reduced if a reported flaw is unlisted in the acceptable minor defects registry, or if the quality controller is missing from the certified inspectors roster. During routing, a roll is sent to the outlet store if its manufacturing region is absent from the premium origins list, or if its texture style is missing from the standard weaves catalog. To prevent duplicates, if a serial number has not been encountered before, it is recorded. If the shipping vendor is absent from the preferred partners list, a surcharge is applied. Furthermore, if the flame retardant coating is missing from the safety standards list, the roll is quarantined. Finally, if the designated storage zone is missing from the active warehouses list, the roll is assigned to a default overflow zone. Return a tuple of lists containing premium rolls and outlet rolls. Example input: a list with one roll having cotton material, blue shade, and no flaws. Output: a tuple with one item in the premium list and an empty outlet list.

title: Spice Blend Mixer
spec: Create a validator for custom seasoning recipes. The entry function `mix(recipes)` processes a list of seasoning requests. A recipe is immediately rejected if its base ingredient is missing from the stocked bases list, or if the requested grind size is absent from the calibrated grinder settings list. The system then reviews the flavor additions. A warning is generated if an herb is unlisted in the culinary safe registry, or if a salt variety is missing from the low sodium alternatives list. If the anti caking agent is absent from the natural preservatives catalog, an artificial label is required. For packaging, a recipe is routed to bulk bags if its target volume is absent from the standard jar capacities list, or if its label design is missing from the preprinted labels catalog. The system must maintain a registry of unique recipe names; if a recipe name has not been seen before, it is added. If the customer account is absent from the active subscribers list, a fee is added. Also, if the mixing speed is unlisted in the safe blending speeds list, manual mixing is enforced. Lastly, if the delivery region is missing from the domestic zones list, international rules apply. Return a tuple containing the valid recipes and a list of generated warnings. Example input: a recipe with pepper base and fine grind. Output: the recipe in the valid list and no warnings.

title: Spacecraft Telemetry Parser
spec: Write a parser for incoming satellite data streams. The entry function `parse(packets)` evaluates a sequence of transmission packets. A packet is discarded if its sensor identifier is missing from the active sensors registry, or if its payload format is absent from the recognized telemetry structures list. For packets that pass, the system processes diagnostic alerts. An alert is flagged as critical if the error code is unlisted in the auto recoverable faults list, or if the reporting subsystem is missing from the non essential components list. If the power state is absent from the safe voltage levels, a brownout warning is logged. During data storage, a packet is archived to cold storage if its mission phase is absent from the current active phases list, or if its data priority is missing from the high bandwidth priorities catalog. To ensure sequence integrity, if a transmission number has not been recorded previously, it is stored. Furthermore, if the ground station is absent from the primary receivers list, a relay delay is noted. If the thermal reading is unlisted in the nominal operating temperatures, a cooling protocol is triggered. Finally, if the encryption protocol is missing from the modern standards list, a security flag is raised. Return the processed critical alerts and the archived data payloads. Example input: a packet from an active sensor with a normal payload format. Output: empty lists for critical alerts and cold storage.

title: Plant Nursery Tracker
spec: Build a tracking system for botanical greenhouse inventory. The function `track(shipments)` handles new arrivals of flora. A shipment is refused if the plant species is missing from the local non invasive species list, or if the soil mixture is absent from the approved greenhouse mediums list. The system then assigns care protocols. A special care tag is added if the watering frequency is unlisted in the standard irrigation schedules list, or if the sunlight requirement is missing from the native climate profiles list. If the pruning method is absent from the safe cutting techniques list, a master botanist is assigned. For placement, a plant is sent to quarantine if its supplier is absent from the trusted vendors list, or if its pest resistance rating is missing from the high immunity categories list. If a container tag has not been cataloged before, it is registered. If the fertilizer brand is absent from the organic certified list, a synthetic warning is logged. Also, if the propagation method is unlisted in the authorized cloning techniques, an experimental tag is attached. Lastly, if the blooming season is missing from the year round displays list, the plant is routed to the seasonal pavilion. Return the list of accepted plants and their care tags. Example input: a shipment of ferns from a trusted vendor. Output: the fern in the accepted list with no special tags.

title: Pottery Kiln Controller
spec: Design a scheduling tool for ceramic firing batches. The function `fire(batches)` organizes pending pottery loads. A batch is delayed if the clay body is missing from the high temperature safe list, or if the glaze composition is absent from the stable chemicals registry. An operator alert is triggered if the temperature ramp rate is unlisted in the standard firing curves list, or if the soak time is missing from the recommended durations catalog. If the venting strategy is absent from the safe exhaust protocols, an air quality warning is activated. For kiln assignment, a batch is routed to the electric kiln if its atmospheric requirement is absent from the reduction environments list, or if its piece size is missing from the large capacity dimensions list. To track progress, if a signature has not been processed recently, it is highlighted for priority. If the protective shelving type is absent from the heavy duty furniture list, a weight limit warning is applied. If the moisture content is unlisted in the bone dry thresholds, a preheating phase is added. Finally, if the cooling method is missing from the rapid cool techniques list, an overnight lock is enforced. Return a list of scheduled batches and a list of operator alerts. Example input: a batch with porcelain clay and standard glaze. Output: the batch scheduled with no alerts.

title: Spell Checker Engine
spec: Create a proofreading engine for technical manuscripts. The function `check(document)` processes a list of text paragraphs. The logic must iterate over each word. It should mark a word as a typo if it is absent from the standard dictionary and also missing from the project specific glossary. If a trailing symbol is unlisted in the approved punctuation list, it generates a formatting warning. Then, it evaluates sentence structures. A sentence is flagged for review if its starting conjunction is not found in the formal transitions catalog. If the sentence length category is absent from the readable pacing metrics, a verbosity alert is issued. During author attribution, if the author name is missing from the registered contributors list, the paragraph is assigned to an anonymous queue. Whenever an acronym has not been encountered before, it is added to an index. If a cited reference identifier is absent from the bibliography keys list, a broken link error is recorded. If the text language is unlisted in the supported dialects list, localization is skipped. If the heading level is missing from the approved document hierarchy, an outline error is logged. Finally, if the font style is unlisted in the publication guidelines, a style error is thrown. Return the corrected text and the compiled errors. Example input: a short paragraph with known words and correct punctuation. Output: the same paragraph and an empty error list.

title: Coffee Roastery Scheduler
spec: Develop a roasting management tool for green coffee beans. The entry point `schedule(beans)` takes a list of bean profiles. The code needs to first eliminate any batch where the origin country is unlisted in the fair trade registry. Next, if the processing method is missing from the washed or natural methods lists, the batch is flagged for manual review. For roast profiling, if the target roast level is absent from the master roast curves catalog, the system assigns a default medium roast. If the bean density is unlisted in the standard hardness profiles, the drum speed is adjusted. The blending module checks companion beans; if a companion bean is not present in the flavor synergy list, a taste warning is issued. If a batch serial number has not been stored in the current daily log, it gets appended. When assigning roasting machines, if the machine identifier is missing from the recently maintained equipment list, the batch is routed to a backup roaster. If the cooling tray time is absent from the rapid quench targets, a staling alert is raised. If the degassing period is unlisted in the optimal resting days list, a freshness warning is added. Lastly, if the packaging size is unlisted in the retail or wholesale dimensions lists, custom packaging is triggered. Return the scheduled batches and manual review flags. Example input: a batch from a fair trade origin with a washed process. Output: scheduled batch with no warnings.

title: Archival Document Digitizer
spec: Implement a processing script for digitizing historical archives. The main function `digitize(records)` handles a collection of manuscript metadata objects. The process should skip a record entirely if its original language is not found in the supported translation matrix. Furthermore, if the manuscript material is missing from the safe handling list, it requires supervisor approval. The optical character recognition phase must check the detected script; if the script type is unlisted in the known historical alphabets, a manual transcription request is created. If the ink type is absent from the fade resistant pigments list, a low light scan is enforced. During metadata tagging, any document whose historical era is absent from the standard timeline periods gets an unclassified tag. If a shelf identifier has not been accessed during the current run, it is marked as active. If the requested output format is missing from the archival file types list, the system defaults to a high resolution image format. Also, if the document watermark is absent from the authenticated marks list, a forgery check is scheduled. If the page dimension is unlisted in the scanner glass sizes, a large format capture is assigned. Finally, if the binding style is missing from the flat lay capable methods, edge distortion correction is enabled. Return a list of processed digital records and supervisor approval requests. Example input: an English manuscript on safe paper. Output: the digitized record and no approval requests.

title: Aquarium Tank Balancer
spec: Write a water quality analysis engine for a large public aquarium. The function `balance(readings)` takes various sensor data points. The engine must issue an immediate critical alarm if the ammonia level falls into a range that is not included in the safe aquatic thresholds list. It must examine the introduced fish species; if a species is missing from the compatible marine life registry, a habitat warning is generated. If the salinity reading is absent from the specific gravity targets, a fresh water top off is initiated. When adjusting water chemistry, if the recommended buffer chemical is unlisted in the approved organic treatments list, the adjustment is blocked. The lighting schedule must be evaluated; if the spectrum setting is absent from the natural reef lighting profiles, it is reset to a default daylight mode. If a pump identifier has not been logged in the active circulation list, a maintenance ticket is opened. For feeding protocols, if the food type is unlisted in the dietary requirements list, a nutritional alert is raised. If the current flow rate is absent from the species required currents list, the wavemakers are adjusted. If the coral frag type is missing from the established growth zones, it is relocated. Finally, if the tank temperature is missing from the tropical zone averages, the heaters are adjusted. Return the updated tank profiles and a list of generated tickets. Example input: normal ammonia levels and compatible fish. Output: unchanged profiles and no tickets.

title: Bicycle Assembly Validator
spec: Construct a validation program for custom bicycle orders. The function `validate(orders)` accepts a list of customer build requests. The system must reject an order if the chosen frame material is not found in the structural integrity database. Additionally, if the requested cassette is missing from the rear derailleur limits list, a mechanical error is logged. The wheel builder module needs to verify the spoke count; if the count is unlisted in the safe tension models, the wheel is marked for manual lacing. If the bottom bracket standard is absent from the frame shell specifications, a compatibility warning is generated. When selecting brakes, if the brake caliper type is absent from the frame mount standards, an adapter is automatically added to the order. If a part number has not been reserved in the warehouse system, it triggers a backorder status. If the handlebar width is unlisted in the ergonomic fit catalog, a sizing warning is communicated to the buyer. If the tire tread pattern is absent from the intended terrain types list, an efficiency warning is appended. If the saddle width is missing from the sit bone measurement ranges, a comfort alert is logged. Lastly, if the chosen paint color is absent from the current year palette, a custom paint fee is applied. Return the confirmed orders and any backorder alerts. Example input: an order with standard frame and compatible drivetrain. Output: confirmed order and no alerts.

title: Perfume Formulator
spec: Create a fragrance blending validator for a perfumery. The entry function `formulate(recipes)` processes multiple scent compositions. The software must discard a recipe if its top note is unlisted in the volatile compounds registry. It then checks the middle notes; if an essence is missing from the dermatologically tested list, a skin safety warning is attached. For the base fixative, if the chosen ingredient is absent from the long lasting fixatives list, the system suggests an alternative. If the essential oil extraction method is unlisted in the pure distillation techniques, an impurity flag is raised. The solvent ratio is verified next; if the alcohol percentage is missing from the standard eau de parfum ranges, the batch is categorized as a custom concentration. If a specific scent combination has not been mixed before, it is flagged as a novel creation. During the bottling phase, if the bottle shape is unlisted in the automated filling machine molds, the recipe is sent to the hand pour queue. If the atomizer spray type is absent from the approved misting nozzles list, a leak test is required. If the dye color is missing from the non staining colorants list, a fabric warning is added. Finally, if the marketing label category is absent from the approved seasonal campaigns list, it gets a generic label. Return the approved formulations and the hand pour queue. Example input: a recipe with safe top and middle notes in standard alcohol. Output: approved formulation and empty queue.

title: Jewelry Appraisal System
spec: Build an appraisal workflow for custom jewelry pieces. The function `appraise(pieces)` takes a collection of jewelry items. The valuation is halted if the primary gemstone is not found in the recognized precious minerals list. The metal purity is examined next; if the alloy blend is missing from the hallmarked standards, the item is marked as costume jewelry. The gemologist module checks the cut style; if the facet pattern is unlisted in the historical cuts catalog, an expert consultation is required. For the setting type, if the mounting method is absent from the secure settings list, a fragility warning is added to the certificate. If the inclusion type is missing from the natural flaw characteristics list, a synthetic stone warning is issued. If the appraiser initials have not been seen in the current session, they are verified against the master staff record. If the clasp mechanism is missing from the reliable closures list, a repair recommendation is made. If the chain link style is unlisted in the durable chains catalog, a stretching warning is appended. If the hallmark stamp is absent from the known assay office marks, provenance research is triggered. Lastly, if the requested insurance tier is unlisted in the covered valuation brackets, a custom policy quote is generated. Return the appraised values and the list of expert consultations. Example input: a piece with a recognized diamond and hallmarked gold. Output: standard appraisal value and no consultations.

title: Bakery Order Processor
spec: Develop an order management system for a commercial bakery. The main function `bake(orders)` handles requested cake designs. The system must decline an order if the dietary request is not found in the supported allergy profiles. It must also check the structural integrity; if the tier stacking method is missing from the stable cake architectures list, a collapse warning is triggered. For flavor profiles, if the fruit filling is unlisted in the seasonal availability calendar, an out of season surcharge is applied. The decoration phase requires validation; if the icing technique is absent from the decorators skill repertoire, the order is delayed. If the food coloring is missing from the FDA approved edible dyes list, a safety error is logged. If a destination zip code has not been routed in the daily manifest, a new delivery zone is opened. If the cake board size is missing from the standard inventory dimensions, a custom board is cut. If the topper material is absent from the food safe plastics list, an inedible warning is printed. If the sponge flavor is unlisted in the standard batters catalog, a test bake is scheduled. Finally, if the event type is unlisted in the priority events list, standard delivery windows apply. Return the accepted orders and the list of new delivery zones. Example input: a standard birthday cake order with local delivery. Output: accepted order and no new zones.

title: Botanical Garden Tour Planner
spec: Program a dynamic route generator for garden visitors. The entry function `plan(visitors)` processes guest preferences. The routing algorithm must skip a garden section if its dominant plant family is unlisted in the current blooming schedules. It also checks accessibility; if a pathway terrain is missing from the wheelchair friendly surfaces list, it is removed from accessible routes. The guided tour module evaluates the requested language; if the language is absent from the available audio guides list, an English default is provided. When selecting rest stops, if a pavilion is missing from the shaded areas list, it is not recommended during peak sun hours. If the difficulty rating is unlisted in the casual walker capabilities, a strenuous activity warning is appended. If a specific botanical interest has not been recorded in the daily analytics, it is tallied. If the requested lunch spot is unlisted in the open cafes directory, alternative food stands are suggested. If the interactive exhibit is absent from the currently operational displays, a detour is generated. If the viewing platform is missing from the safely inspected structures list, it is bypassed. Lastly, if the exit gate is absent from the evening access points list, a routing warning directs them to the main gate. Return the customized tour routes and tally metrics. Example input: a visitor wanting accessible paths and English audio. Output: a flat route with blooming sections.

title: Vintage Watch Authenticator
spec: Write a validation script for a vintage horology marketplace. The function `authenticate(watches)` inspects submitted timepiece details. A submission is immediately rejected if the manufacturer is not found in the historical brand registry. The movement check verifies the caliber; if the caliber is missing from the documented production runs, a counterfeit flag is raised. The dial inspection examines the typography; if the font style is unlisted in the era specific design catalogs, the watch is marked for manual review. For case materials, if the metal composition is absent from the period accurate alloys list, an aftermarket modification note is added. If the luminous material is missing from the safe tritium or radium limits, a radiation hazard warning is logged. If a serial number has not been checked against the stolen property database, a background query is initiated. If the crown type is missing from the waterproof standards list of that decade, a water damage warning is appended. If the bezel style is unlisted in the authentic divers configurations, a frankenwatch tag is applied. If the crystal material is absent from the original factory specs list, a replacement note is added. Finally, if the seller rating is unlisted in the trusted merchants tier, escrow payment is mandated. Return the authenticated watches and counterfeit flags. Example input: a watch with historical brand and documented caliber. Output: authenticated watch and no flags.

title: Brewery Fermentation Monitor
spec: Design an automated monitoring script for craft beer fermentation. The main function `brew(tanks)` reads data from various vats. The process must trigger a dump valve if the detected bacterial strain is not found in the safe brewing cultures list. The gravity module checks the sugar consumption; if the current gravity drop rate is missing from the expected fermentation curves, a stalled fermentation alert is generated. When evaluating temperature, if the thermal reading is unlisted in the yeast specific optimal ranges, the cooling jacket is activated. The dry hopping schedule is verified; if the hop variety is absent from the scheduled additions list, the automated hopper remains closed. If the pH level is missing from the sour or standard thresholds, an acid adjustment is triggered. If a shift supervisor has not been logged in the access history, an unauthorized access event is recorded. If the carbonation level is missing from the target style volumes, CO2 injection is adjusted. If the dissolved oxygen reading is unlisted in the low oxidation limits, a staling risk is flagged. If the clarity measurement is absent from the acceptable turbidity metrics, fining agents are added. Lastly, if the tank pressure is unlisted in the safe operational thresholds, a pressure relief valve opens. Return the status of each tank and a list of generated alerts. Example input: a tank with safe culture and optimal temperature. Output: normal status and no alerts.

title: Sailing Regatta Scorer
spec: Implement a race scoring and penalty system for sailing regattas. The entry function `score(entries)` takes race finish data. A boat is disqualified if its hull class is not found in the official regatta categories. The handicap calculator checks the sail configuration; if the spinnaker size is missing from the allowed dimensions list, a time penalty is applied. The wind condition module verifies the recorded wind speeds during the race; if a gust reading is unlisted in the safe racing limits, the race segment might be invalidated. For crew weighing, if a crew member weight is absent from the registered roster limits, a rules violation is flagged. If the hull material is missing from the one design class rules, a modification penalty is added. If a designated buoy has not been recorded in the GPS track, the boat receives a missed mark penalty. If the protest flag status is missing from the valid protest codes, the appeal is dismissed. If the safety equipment list is unlisted in the mandatory coast guard requirements, a pre race disqualification is issued. If the radio channel is absent from the official race committee frequencies, a communication warning is sent. Finally, if the boat insurance is unlisted in the active policies registry, prize money is withheld. Return the final standings and the list of disqualified boats. Example input: a boat in an official class with valid sail size. Output: calculated standing and no disqualifications.

title: Cheese Aging Tracker
spec: Create an inventory and maturation tracker for an artisanal cheese cave. The function `age(wheels)` evaluates data for stored cheese wheels. The system must discard a wheel if the surface mold is not found in the beneficial cultures registry. The humidity tracker checks the ambient moisture; if the moisture level is missing from the style specific target ranges, a climate control alert is dispatched. During the turning schedule phase, if a wheel size is unlisted in the automated flipper capacities list, it is added to the manual turning manifest. For rind washing, if the brining solution is absent from the traditional recipes catalog, a flavor deviation note is recorded. If the cave temperature is missing from the optimal maturation thermal limits, the cooling system is boosted. If a sensory descriptor has not been logged in the master flavor wheel, it highlights it as a unique batch. If the aging duration is missing from the minimum maturation milestones, the wheel cannot be labeled as reserve. If the milk type is unlisted in the pasteurized or raw safe lists, a health department flag is raised. If the piercing frequency is absent from the blue cheese aeration standards, a mold growth warning is appended. Lastly, if the packaging material is unlisted in the breathable wraps list, a moisture trap warning is issued. Return the updated wheel statuses and the manual turning manifest. Example input: a wheel with beneficial mold and correct humidity. Output: maturing status and no alerts.

title: Astronomy Observatory Scheduler
spec: Program a telescope time allocation system. The entry function `allocate(proposals)` reviews astronomer requests. A proposal is instantly denied if the target celestial object is not found in the currently visible hemisphere coordinates. The instrument check verifies the sensor requirements; if the requested spectrometer is missing from the calibrated instruments list, a maintenance hold is applied. The tracking module evaluates the exposure time; if the duration is unlisted in the stable tracking windows, the observation is split into smaller segments. For data storage, if the expected data volume is absent from the available server capacities list, cloud offloading is scheduled. If the required filter is missing from the optical filter wheel slots, a physical swap is requested. If a researcher has not been verified in the institutional directory, an affiliation check is prompted. If the calibration star is missing from the standard reference catalog, an alternative star is automatically selected. If the seeing condition requirement is unlisted in the historical atmospheric turbulence models, a low priority tag is assigned. If the lunar phase tolerance is absent from the sky brightness limits, the observation is constrained. Finally, if the weather tolerance is unlisted in the dome open conditions, the session is marked as weather dependent. Return the approved schedule and the list of denied proposals. Example input: a proposal for a visible object with a calibrated sensor. Output: scheduled session and empty denied list.

title: Lighthouse Maintenance Logger
spec: Build a reporting tool for maritime navigational aids. The main function `maintain(reports)` processes lighthouse inspection logs. A report generates an emergency work order if the main beacon status is not found in the operational states list. The power module checks the backup generator; if the fuel type is missing from the authorized maritime fuels, an environmental citation is issued. The structural inspection evaluates the masonry; if a crack width is unlisted in the safe tolerance measurements, a structural engineer is dispatched. For the fog horn system, if the sound frequency is absent from the internationally recognized signals list, a recalibration is ordered. If the battery bank voltage is missing from the deep cycle charge thresholds, a solar panel check is triggered. If a lens component has not been sourced from the historical preservation suppliers, it is flagged as inauthentic. If the remote telemetry link is missing from the active communication protocols, a manual watch is required. If the lightning rod resistance is unlisted in the safe grounding values, an electrician is called. If the paint color is absent from the official daymark patterns, a repainting schedule is created. Lastly, if the keeper certification is unlisted in the current coast guard registry, a training mandate is sent. Return the generated work orders and engineer dispatches. Example input: a report with operational beacon and safe masonry. Output: empty work orders and no dispatches.

title: Tea Blending Evaluator
spec: Write a quality control script for custom loose leaf teas. The function `blend(teas)` takes multiple custom tea profiles. The blending process is halted if the base tea leaf is not found in the ethically sourced plantations list. The temperature module checks the brewing instructions; if the recommended water temperature is missing from the standard steeping profiles, a brewing warning is printed on the label. spec: Write a function `certify(components)` that takes a sequence of eight strings representing a spacecraft design. title: Historical Manuscript Authenticator
spec: Write a function `authenticate(traits)` that accepts a sequence of eight string properties of a historical document. title: Medieval Banquet Planner
spec: Write a function `plan(feast)` that evaluates a tuple of eight food items for a royal banquet. The items in order correspond to meat, fish, vegetable, fruit, bread, wine, cheese, and dessert. The royal meats are venison and boar. The freshwater fishes are trout and salmon. The seasonal vegetables are turnip and cabbage. The king fruits are apple and pear. Return a list of strings stating the category name of any item that is unacceptable. Passing venison, trout, turnip, apple, rye, red, brie, and dirt will return a list with the word dessert.

title: Wizards Tower Architect
spec: Write a function `inspect(materials)` that receives eight structural choices for a wizard tower. The sequence represents foundation, mortar, wood, roof, window, door, stairs, and spire. The resistant foundations are granite and basalt. The binding mortars are ash and clay. The enchanted woods are oak and yew. The dragon roofs are slate and tile. The clear windows are quartz and glass. The forged doors are iron and steel. The sacred stairs are spiral and straight. The channeling spires are gold and silver. Verify each choice. Return a list of eight booleans in the same order, where true means the choice is valid and false means it is absent from the allowed list. Passing granite, ash, oak, slate, quartz, iron, spiral, and wood returns seven true values and one false value at the end.

title: Pirate Ship Outfitter
spec: Write a function `outfit(supplies)` taking eight strings for ship supplies. The items in order correspond to cannon, sail, rope, figurehead, rum, powder, cutlass, and compass. The black market cannons are brass and iron. The storm sails are canvas and linen. The kraken ropes are hemp and silk. The cursed figureheads are mermaid and skull. The smuggled rums are dark and spiced. The volatile powders are black and grey. The naval cutlasses are steel and bronze. The magnetic compasses are brass and wood. Example: if the input is brass, canvas, hemp, skull, dark, black, steel, and plastic, the output is a list containing the word compass.

title: Cyberpunk Mercenary Gear
spec: Write a function `equip(loadout)` that examines an eight item gear selection. The sequence maps to implant, optic, arm, leg, sidearm, melee, deck, and clothing. The underground implants are neural and spine. The military optics are thermal and night. The industrial arms are hydraulic and servo. The composite legs are carbon and alloy. The unregistered sidearms are pistol and revolver. The monomolecular melees are katana and knife. The stealth decks are cyber and shadow. The masking clothings are synth and leather. title: Vampire Lair Decorator
spec: Write a function `decorate(furnishings)` that checks eight decor elements. The categories in order are coffin, soil, drape, chandelier, candelabra, portrait, rug, and goblet.
