The tarnished candelabras are silver and pewter. The renaissance portraits are oil and sketch. The crimson rugs are wool and bear. The jeweled goblets are gold and platinum. If the input is pine, dirt, velvet, iron, silver, oil, wool, and cup, the output is a list containing the word goblet.

title: Superhero Base Security
spec: Write a function `secure(defenses)` that validates an eight element defense layout. The sequence is wall, vault, alarm, grid, training, medical, hangar, and core. The danger trainings are holo and sim. The regeneration medicals are tank and pod. The cloaked hangars are stealth and hidden. The quantum cores are super and mega. title: Steampunk Airship Engineer
spec: Write a function `certify(parts)` that receives eight airship components. The positions match balloon, gas, boiler, propeller, pipe, navigation, goggles, and cabin. title: Ninja Clan Arsenal
spec: Write a function `stock(weapons)` checking eight ninja items. The categories are shuriken, katana, smoke, hook, claw, suit, poison, and caltrop. The star shurikens are four and eight. The folded katanas are steel and iron. The blinding smokes are ash and flash. The silent hooks are iron and rope. The climbing claws are steel and brass. The stealth suits are black and grey. An input of four, steel, ash, iron, steel, black, toad, and plastic results in a list containing caltrop.

title: Haunted House Prop Master
spec: Write a function `approve(props)` taking eight prop descriptions. The sequence corresponds to cobweb, skeleton, doll, fog, sound, light, blood, and tombstone. title: Interstellar Outpost Blueprint
spec: Write a function `establish(modules)` that processes eight colony parts. The positions match habitat, crop, purifier, panel, rover, drill, relay, and scanner. spec: Write a function `arrange(details)` to verify eight wedding choices. The items are carriage, steed, gown, slipper, hall, flower, musician, and ring. title: Time Traveler Itinerary
spec: Write a function `verify(plans)` receiving eight travel parameters. The sequence represents departure, arrival, disguise, currency, language, dampener, beacon, and gadget. title: Dinosaur Park Manager
spec: Write a function `evaluate(safeguards)` validating eight park systems. The sequence is fence, feeder, implant, moat, glass, sign, bunker, and dart. The electric fences are high and max. spec: Write a function `delegate(diplomacy)` that checks eight ambassadorial choices. The items are wear, device, transport, gift, gesture, room, diet, and guard. The neutral wears are grey and blue. title: Wild West Town Sheriff
spec: Write a function `patrol(assets)` checking eight town features. The positions map to piano, cell, vault, trough, post, poster, spittoon, and store. The upright pianos are wood and old. spec: Write a function `calculate(tactics)` evaluating eight assault vectors. The sequence represents city, unit, pulse, jammer, drone, transport, hack, and weapon. title: Underwater City Architect

title: Arctic Expedition Leader
spec: Write a function `prepare(gear)` verifying eight survival items. The categories are dog, parka, tent, stove, ration, navigation, snowshoe, and axe. The endurance dogs are husky and malamute. For husky, down, dome, gas, meat, gps, wood, and plastic, the output is a list with axe.

title: Desert Oasis Landscaper
spec: Write a function `cultivate(plants)` assessing eight garden features. The sequence translates to tree, irrigation, barrier, water, cover, pathway, seating, and illumination. spec: Write a function `issue(gear)` validating eight spy tools. The items match watch, pen, car, shoe, glasses, briefcase, umbrella, and cufflink. The laser watches are gold and silver. title: Volcano Observatory Scientist
spec: Write a function `monitor(equipment)` checking eight monitoring tools. The sequence maps to seismometer, analyzer, camera, drone, suit, container, radio, and vehicle. title: Alchemist Laboratory Manager
spec: Write a function `audit(apparatus)` evaluating eight lab instruments. The categories are crucible, flask, mortar, burner, rod, cabinet, ventilation, and scale. title: Mythological Bestiary Compiler
spec: Write a function `catalog(traits)` validating eight creature characteristics. The sequence corresponds to habitat, diet, attack, defense, weakness, reproduction, lifespan, and alignment. The mythical habitats are cave and sky. The magical diets are soul and star. The elemental attacks are fire and ice. The impenetrable defenses are scale and aura. Return the number of characteristics that do not match known mythological records. Given cave, soul, fire, scale, iron, egg, eternal, and neutral, the result is one.

title: Drone Flight Path Optimizer
spec: Write a function `optimize(flights, hazards)` to assess drone delivery safety by building a checklist. Each flight is a dictionary with keys pilot, drone, battery, payload, route, altitude, weather, and time. The hazards dictionary contains sets of dangerous values under keys pilots, drones, batteries, payloads, routes, altitudes, weathers, and times. Create three helper functions to generate a safety list per flight. The crew helper appends the string safe pilot to a list if the pilot is not in the hazards pilots, and good time if the time is not in the hazards times. The hardware helper appends sound drone if the drone is not in the hazards drones, strong battery if the battery is not in the hazards batteries, and light payload if the payload is not in the hazards payloads. The navigation helper appends clear route if the route is not in the hazards routes, fine altitude if the altitude is not in the hazards altitudes, and calm weather if the weather is not in the hazards weathers. Return a list of safety lists.

title: Digital Wallet Transaction Sorter
spec: Write a function `sort(transactions, blacklists)` to evaluate the legitimacy of digital payments by collecting clearance tags. Each transaction has keys sender, recipient, currency, amount, ip, device, browser, and location. The blacklists contain suspicious sets under keys senders, recipients, currencies, amounts, ips, devices, browsers, and locations. Divide the evaluation into three helper functions to build a list of tags for each transaction. The identity helper appends the string trusted sender if the sender is not in the blacklists senders, and trusted recipient if the recipient is not in the blacklists recipients. The financial helper appends safe currency if the currency is not in the blacklists currencies, and normal amount if the amount is not in the blacklists amounts. The technical helper appends clean ip if the ip is not in the blacklists ips, recognized device if the device is not in the blacklists devices, safe browser if the browser is not in the blacklists browsers, and verified location if the location is not in the blacklists locations. Return a list of tag lists.

title: Concert Stage Rigging Validator
spec: Write a function `validate(rigs, warnings)` to assemble safety approvals for concert stage setups. Each rig includes keys truss, motor, cable, fixture, power, controller, operator, and sequence. The warnings structure holds dangerous values under keys trusses, motors, cables, fixtures, powers, controllers, operators, and sequences. Split the validation into three helper functions that add strings to an approval list for each rig. The structural helper appends the string solid truss if the truss is not in the warnings trusses, and strong motor if the motor is not in the warnings motors. The electrical helper appends safe cable if the cable is not in the warnings cables, cool fixture if the fixture is not in the warnings fixtures, and stable power if the power is not in the warnings powers. The control helper appends reliable controller if the controller is not in the warnings controllers, trained operator if the operator is not in the warnings operators, and tested sequence if the sequence is not in the warnings sequences. Return a list of approval lists.

title: Telescope Lens Calibrator
spec: Write a function `calibrate(observations, anomalies)` to determine the reliability of deep space observations by building a status list. An observation contains keys filter, lens, sensor, mount, tracking, focus, temperature, and humidity. The anomalies dataset contains problematic sets under keys filters, lenses, sensors, mounts, trackings, focuses, temperatures, and humidities. Organize the calculation into three helper functions that populate a list for each observation. The optical helper appends the string clean filter if the filter is not in the anomalies filters, and clear lens if the lens is not in the anomalies lenses. The mechanical helper appends active sensor if the sensor is not in the anomalies sensors, stable mount if the mount is not in the anomalies mounts, and precise tracking if the tracking is not in the anomalies trackings. The environmental helper appends sharp focus if the focus is not in the anomalies focuses, mild temperature if the temperature is not in the anomalies temperatures, and dry humidity if the humidity is not in the anomalies humidities. Return a list of status lists.

title: Coral Reef Monitoring System
spec: Write a function `monitor(sensors, hazards)` to compile health reports for coral reef sectors. Each sensor provides keys polyp, algae, sponge, crustacean, current, visibility, acidity, and toxin. The hazards object holds danger thresholds under keys polyps, algaes, sponges, crustaceans, currents, visibilities, acidities, and toxins. Divide the logic into three helper functions to build a status list per sensor. The biology helper adds the string healthy polyp if the polyp is not in the hazards polyps, and normal algae if the algae is not in the hazards algaes. The ecosystem helper adds safe sponge if the sponge is not in the hazards sponges, active crustacean if the crustacean is not in the hazards crustaceans, and steady current if the current is not in the hazards currents. The water helper adds clear visibility if the visibility is not in the hazards visibilities, balanced acidity if the acidity is not in the hazards acidities, and zero toxin if the toxin is not in the hazards toxins. Return a list of the status lists.

title: Highway Toll Booth Validator
spec: Write a function `validate(vehicles, blacklists)` to issue clearance tags for vehicles at automated toll booths. Each vehicle has keys transponder, license, axle, trailer, weight, height, emission, and toll.
